content_sections.heading: PCCF & HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Computer Assistant and 1 for GIS Analyst.

content_sections.text: Computer Assistant: Graduation in any discipline. One year Diploma in Computer Application from any Govt. recognized University/ Institute. Minimum 5 years work experience in Forestry sector. GIS Analyst: Master's degree in GIS and Remote Sensing. Minimum 5 years work experience with spatial software (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS, ERDAS Imagine).

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PCCF & HoFF Assam Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PCCF & HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21st September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by PCCF & HoFF Assam?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Computer Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Computer Assistant post, candidates need to have a Graduation in any discipline along with a One-year Diploma in Computer Application and at least 5 years of work experience in the Forestry sector.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Both the Computer Assistant and GIS Analyst positions offer a fixed salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years as of 1st January 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. They should prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PCCF & HoFF Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the experience required for the GIS Analyst post?
faq.answer: For the GIS Analyst position, candidates must possess a Master's degree in GIS and Remote Sensing and have a minimum of 5 years of work experience with spatial software like ArcGIS, QGIS, or ERDAS Imagine.
